sentences.text: The animal is known from numerous fragmentary head shields and body armours.
It possessed a pronounced, serrated spinal plate that created a crescent-shaped dorsal silhouette.
The genus Kujdanowiaspis was first described by Stensiö in 1942.
Its body shape and large lateral spinal plates suggest it lived a benthic lifestyle near the bottom of the water.
Its underdeveloped jaws suggest it likely ate smaller, softer prey like mollusks or worms rather than tough animals.
Kujdanowiaspis is classified within the class Placodermi.
It belongs to the family Kujdanowiaspididae.
The genus is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira.
Three species were originally described for the genus in 1934: K. buczacziensis, K. podolica, and K. rectiformis.
A species named Kujdanowiaspis zychi in 1945 was later moved to the genus Erikaspis in 2007.
Kujdanowiaspis lived during the Early Devonian period.
The genus lived between 419.62 and 410.62 million years ago, spanning the Lochkovian to Pragian stages.
Fossils of Kujdanowiaspis have been found in Podolia (Ukraine), Poland, and Spain.
